name: astro-ph-researcher
description: Astronomy workbench for Codex: NADC-validated terms, a local reference library, journal/thesis format guidance, ten goal-aware writing styles, and an observatory/data-workflow directory.

interface.shortDescription: 天文术语、文献库、写作目标与观测数据工作流
interface.longDescription: 面向天文学生与研究者的 Codex 插件：NADC 术语核验、文献检索与参考文献库、期刊/高校写作格式、10 个目标感知的写作风格（发现/确认/批判/增量/上限/方法/巡天/理论/多信使/综述）、34 个数据处理方法与 9 条统计原理、30 个观测设施的数据/软件/工作流。数据只读本地 JSON；不抓取付费全文、不绕过数据专有期。
defaultPrompt: Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-literature-research to build a verifiable astronomy reading list.
Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-code-writing to write reproducible astronomy code.
Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-english-journal-writing to outline and revise my paper.
